title: The tarp off
logline: The lawn chair in July with its tarp off and folded under it, the webbing faded another shade, the bay. Seventeen summers of one chair. The page draws the fold.

panels.composition: An old aluminum lawn chair on a dock in July with a folded tarp beneath it, the webbing faded, the bay bright.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, an old aluminum lawn chair on a wooden dock in July with a folded tarp beneath it and faded webbing, a bright bay beyond, no people, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
